cards.hypothesis: When two or more same-priority feasible tasks compete for scarce workers or shared inventory, a small deterministic rectangular assignment can improve completed-task value without reducing any higher-priority completion, while remaining much faster than the rejected global bitmask DP.
cards.single_delta: Inside the existing formal worker allocator, invoke a capped O(n^3) rectangular assignment only on a preregistered rare-contention subset. Keep task generation, market policy, herd/crop plan, priorities and every non-trigger action exact to the frozen control.
must_not_repeat: The B1/B2/B4 top-18 global bitmask DP or its objective under a different name.
Deadline priority changes, market changes, herd changes or opponent-identity branches in the same candidate.
A SciPy dependency unless the exact Kaggle environment and package payload are independently verified.
safety_contract: Formal priority is lexicographically dominant; no lower-priority assignment may strand a higher-priority feasible task.
Shared WHEAT/COW/SHEEP/seed inventory is reserved in official execution order.
PASS dummy jobs make unassigned workers/tasks explicit.
Matrix size and execution time are hard capped; any invariant failure returns exact control action vector.
No opponent identity, replay path, episode number or exposed seed appears in the action path.
development_falsifiers: paired match or money improvement is negative on the diverse external-opponent aggregate
any protected non-contention action differs from control
benefit appears only against one source lineage or one seat

Kag_02 is distinct only if exact code proves a frozen finite uncertainty set, bounded receding horizon, first-action-only execution and strict fallback/gates rather than a renamed price-impact/future heuristic.

cards.hypothesis: A one-to-two-day receding-horizon choice over a small fixed set of market/resource plans can improve tail cash and direct margin when plans are scored under preregistered price, inventory and opponent-response scenarios, while exact fallback prevents impossible orders and protected-lane regressions.
cards.single_delta: At a narrow market/resource trigger, enumerate a fixed capped plan set, evaluate each plan over a frozen uncertainty set, execute only the first market action, then replan next observation. All worker actions, task allocation and non-trigger market actions remain exact control.
must_not_repeat: A1 self-order price arithmetic, A2 visible-state herd target or A4 combination under a new name.
A large global DP or deep online MCTS.
Post-seed changes to horizon, scenario set, robust penalty, candidate plans or trigger.
safety_contract: Projection matches official farmer, hands and market order with shed capacity, market cap and impossible-SELL checks.
Horizon, plan set, uncertainty scenarios and robust score are frozen before any fresh seed opens.
Only the first action is emitted; next state replans from observation.
Malformed state, projection disagreement, timeout or infeasible plan returns exact control.
No overflow, discard, duplicate market order, negative inventory or impossible quantity may be candidate-caused.
development_falsifiers: AST/action-diff analysis shows equivalence to A1/A2/A4
trigger or action change count is zero
nominal direct margin falls below the preregistered noninferiority gate
paired p10/worst-scenario money does not improve
any opponent mean money delta violates its floor
projection error, impossible order, overflow/discard or runtime failure is nonzero

cards.hypothesis: A fixed classifier over early observable behavior may choose between frozen policies better than a single policy on lineage-held-out opponents.
cards.minimum_delta: Choose one of two already-frozen experts from early action/state features; no online learning.

Need counterfactual replay showing both experts are selected and each selection is causal.
